timing_definitions.solver: Recorded in-process solve wall timer including internal model/search/plan/replay, excluding child startup and outer replay/encoding/network. Historical timers; not CPU time.
timing_definitions.server: Server task creation to successful submission; owns30s eligibility. Late recovery includes original task age, research and waiting; not server CPU.
timing_definitions.client: Fresh attempt start before create through task/progress readback. Excludes preflight, CLI startup and inter-task gaps. Cleanup recovery window is separate, not comparable.
timing_definitions.acquisition: Creation request through task-ID reconciliation, including GET lookups and pauses. May include waiting before actual server task creation.
timing_definitions.remainder: Fresh client window minus acquisition minus recorded solve; remaining stages unmeasured. Server duration overlaps client phases and is not additive.
